exposure: Maternal dietary caffeine intake during the last trimester
cohort: The study included 203 mother-child pairs from the Kuopio Birth Cohort (KuBiCo) where both maternal third trimester dietary caffeine intake and newborn hair caffeine content were measured.
finding: Maternal dietary caffeine intake during the third trimester correlated significantly with caffeine content in newborn hair (r = 0.50; p < 0.001).
cross-section timing: Maternal third trimester (for diet) and within 48 hours after birth (for newborn hair)
